title: Stuffed Artichokes
subtitle: Whole artichokes packed with herbed breadcrumbs and baked in broth
excerpt: Whole artichokes filled between their leaves with garlicky breadcrumbs and parmesan, then steamed and baked until tender. A classic Italian-American table dish that rewards patience.
sourceNotes: Italian-American home cooking tradition, common in Sicilian-American households. Synthesised from multiple home cook sources.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Prepare and stuff the artichokes up to 4 hours ahead. Refrigerate and bake when needed.

content.text: Stuffed artichokes take time but very little skill. You open the leaves, pack crumbs between them and let the oven do the work. Rub the cut surfaces with lemon the moment you trim them or they will go grey quickly.

items.prepNote: one for rubbing, one for the baking liquid

content.text: Cut the top third off each artichoke. Snip the sharp tips from the outer leaves with scissors. Rub all cut surfaces immediately with a halved lemon.
Spread the leaves apart from the centre. Pull out the pale inner leaves and scrape out the fuzzy choke with a spoon.
Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, pecorino, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper in a bowl. Add the olive oil and stir until combined.
Pack the crumb mixture between the leaves, working from the outside in. Fill the central cavity too.
Heat the oven to 190C. Sit the artichokes upright in a snug roasting tin. Pour the stock and the juice of the second lemon into the tin.
Drizzle extra olive oil over the top of each artichoke. Cover the tin tightly with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for a further 15 minutes until the crumbs are golden and a leaf pulls away easily.

items.symptom: The artichoke leaves are still tough after an hour.
items.cause: The artichokes were very large, or the stock level was too low.
items.fix: Add a splash more stock to the tin, re-cover and bake for another 15 minutes. Large artichokes can take 75 minutes total.

items.symptom: The crumbs burn before the artichoke is done.
items.cause: The oven runs hot or the foil was removed too early.
items.fix: Keep the foil on for the full 45 minutes before uncovering. Cover loosely again if the crumbs colour before the leaves are tender.

items.symptom: The artichokes went brown before cooking.
items.cause: Cut surfaces were not rubbed with lemon fast enough.
items.fix: Have the lemon ready before you cut. Rub each surface within seconds of trimming.
